page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening). Running head at top with page number at top right. Full-width chapter heading and subtitle centred. Below, a bracketed diagram (tree) with boxes at several levels, with cross-references at its right. Below the diagram a signature line. Left edge shows fragments of the facing page (partial text in the gutter), which are not transcribed.

main_text.head: CAPVT XIX.
De Multiplici proportione, & primùm de composita per Additionem, vulgò SOCIETATIS dicta.
main_text.l: H. Multiplex proportio est terminis aut
Pluribus, ut ea quæ coponi tur Multiplicatione & additione simul CAP. XXI.

page.notes: Diagram reproduced as an outline; the brace structure is read from the drawing. Left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are omitted. The final line "SIM-" is a catchword-like fragment at the foot of the diagram; its completion is not visible.
